title: Path Add, Path Sum
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Same input protocol; operations: "1 u v x" — add x to
every vertex on the path u..v; "2 u v" — print the SUM of values on the
path u..v, one per line.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200 000; |val|, |x| ≤ 10^9 (sums fit in
long long).

HLD + lazy range-add/range-sum tree. The load test is a bamboo with
2·10^5 path operations — the per-op parent climb times out.

tests.name: hand tree sums
tests.hint: Sum after add 10: 14+12+11+13+16 = 66; path 5..2 sums 17; after -3 on 2..5, path 4..5 sums 13+2+5+5 = 25.

tests.name: bamboo, 200000 full-suffix ops
tests.hint: Every op touches a path of length up to n on a bamboo: the per-op parent climb is O(n) — timeout; HLD + lazy tree is log^2.
